prompt:
Independently audit this contract against the indexed spec only.
Check (1) every spec segment mapped to a rule or marked unrelated/missing, (2) absent verbatim
evidence without uncertain, (3) contradictions between rule fields and examples, (4) plausible
alternative semantics with a concrete distinguishing chronological input sequence, and (5) derive
outputs for any explicit spec waveform/table/examples and compare. Report distinct material issues.
Return JSON {coverage:{Sxx:[rule IDs or "unrelated"/"missing"]},issues:[
{issue_id,rule_id (or "global"),type:"coverage"|"grounding"|"consistency"|"ambiguity"|"spec_example",
severity:"high"|"medium"|"low",detail,spec_evidence (verbatim spec or ""),alternative,sequence}]}.
Keep any deliberation brief and use short issue descriptions so the entire JSON fits. For ambiguity
the alternative must be specific; sequence must be a nonempty list of complete
width-valid nonclock input rows (optional mid) using the contract ports. For other types alternative
can be an empty string and sequence can be []. Code and prose outside JSON are not needed.
Indexed specification:
{"S01":"Create 8 D flip-flops with active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero.","S02":"All DFFs should be triggered by the positive edge of clk."}
Contract JSON:
{"ports":{"inputs":{"d":8,"reset":1},"outputs":{"q":8},"clock":"clk"},"states":[{"name":"q_reg","meaning":"8-bit flip-flop output register holding q","update_time":"posedge clk","update_during_reset":true}],"rules":[{"id":"R1_sync_reset","outputs":["q"],"condition":"reset == 1","edge":"posedge","visible":"next_cycle","priority":1,"spec_quote":"active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":170,"reset":1},{"d":85,"reset":0},{"d":15,"reset":0}],"expected":[{"q":0},{"q":0},{"q":85}]}},{"id":"R2_dff_capture","outputs":["q"],"condition":"reset == 0","edge":"posedge","visible":"next_cycle","priority":2,"spec_quote":"Create 8 D flip-flops","uncertain":false,"example":{"vectors":[{"d":1,"reset":0},{"d":2,"reset":0},{"d":255,"reset":0}],"expected":[{"q":1},{"q":2},{"q":255}]}}],"reset":{"kind":"sync","name":"reset","active":"high","values":{"q":0},"first_released_cycle":"first posedge clk with reset == 0"},"mid":"Optional mid input changes occur AFTER sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row.","uncertain":[]}
response: {"coverage":{"S01":["R1_sync_reset","R2_dff_capture"],"S02":["R1_sync_reset","R2_dff_capture"]},"issues":[{"issue_id":"I1","rule_id":"R1_sync_reset","type":"consistency","severity":"high","detail":"Reset example expected[1] q=0 contradicts rule: at second posedge reset==0 so q should capture d=85, not 0.","spec_evidence":"active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero","alternative":"","sequence":[]},{"issue_id":"I2","rule_id":"R2_dff_capture","type":"consistency","severity":"high","detail":"Capture example omits reset field; with reset unspecified/0 it is fine, but expected[0] q=1 implies prior state ignored; also no reset column makes vectors width-invalid vs ports.","spec_evidence":"Create 8 D flip-flops","alternative":"","sequence":[]},{"issue_id":"I3","rule_id":"global","type":"ambiguity","severity":"medium","detail":"Spec does not state reset priority vs D capture when reset=1 and d nonzero; contract assumes reset wins.","spec_evidence":"active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero","alternative":"D capture has priority over reset, so q<=d even when reset==1","sequence":[{"d":170,"reset":1},{"d":85,"reset":0}]},{"issue_id":"I4","rule_id":"global","type":"ambiguity","severity":"low","detail":"Spec silent on initial q before first posedge; contract does not define power-up value.","spec_evidence":"","alternative":"q initializes to 0 at time 0 before any clock edge","sequence":[{"d":255,"reset":0}]},{"issue_id":"I5","rule_id":"R1_sync_reset","type":"grounding","severity":"low","detail":"Rule quote supports reset-to-zero but not the specific example expected values; example not derivable from spec alone.","spec_evidence":"active high synchronous reset setting the output to zero","alternative":"","sequence":[]}]}
